title: Require Agent Plugin Lifecycle Public Projection
forbids: a foreign native command ID or alias, direct lifecycle client construction, private lifecycle implementation acquisition, or a second service-use owner
why: The topic adapts native CLI inputs into one managed public lifecycle client. The service owns domain validation and operations; the app owns resources and process startup.
remediate: Use the exact native SDK command IDs, declare the single public serviceRuntimeExport use in services.ts, and import lifecycle values and types only from the public client face.
message: Agent-plugin commands must remain exact native projections of the public lifecycle service.
